question: Which exact attention operation carries the block8H1 writer response through the jointly sufficient block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3 subject readers: routing-pattern change, value change under the base pattern, or their interaction?

prior_art_search.relation: The older L9 test found local value change carried 99% of a different original-cue intervention but did not test the fresh block8H1 writer response, block11H3, joint ordered reader installation, or the cross-reader operation. This is a new exact-operation composition test, not a repeat head search.

frozen_design.population: the prospectively manifested 29 A1 and 30 A2 fresh row pairs capable on both sides
frozen_design.writer: exact changed-cue source term of block8H1 installed at both subject-onset destinations
frozen_design.readers: block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3, each at the final prediction query and restricted to the two subject-onset sources
frozen_design.arms: all eight exact subsets of the three factors, with each chosen factor installed at both reader layers in causal order

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_fa: all authorities match; all selected rows are in the prospective manifest; attention reconstruction and P'V'-PV factor closure are <=1e-4
predictions.pred_b_full_factor_response_recurs: the three-factor joint response retains [0.85,1.15] of the previously captured writer-free two-reader response in A1 and A2, with >=0.75 donorward rows
predictions.pred_c_base_pattern_value_change_dominat: the value-change singleton retains >=0.70 of the full-factor response in both A1 and A2 and has the largest Shapley value in both
predictions.pred_d_routing_and_interaction_are_secon: pattern-only and interaction-only each have absolute retention <=0.30 in both families; pattern+value retains >=0.85
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: no fitting, backwards, model updates, rank selection, or post-result row selection; declared price and record coverage are exact

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, capability, exactness, recurrence, coverage, or price fails
terminal_rules.screen: all five predictions pass: a shared value-update reader operation is identified
terminal_rules.null: the exact joint response recurs but the value-dominance or secondary-factor account fails

interpretation_limits: This splits a fixed causal path by exact attention algebra; it does not search heads or optimize a subspace.
A pass identifies the operation used by this fresh cue writer. Cross-cue stability remains a separate prospective test.
A null preserves the exact reader path while rejecting a shared value-update simplification.
